nightly-evals-bot: nightly-evals: model redwood-7b-q5_0-int8 produced 23 toolcall schema failures on prompt_set/tooling_checks — 18 invalid JSON parse errors, 5 type coercions. First occurrence at 2150001111.

Devon: Ugh, quant rollout again? Can you paste a failing output and the exact prompt?

nightly-evals-bot: reproducer snippet: 
```
{"tool_name":"search","args":"{\"ids\":\"[\"123\", \"456\"]\",\"filters\":null}"}
```
also seen: truncated UTF-8 at end of stream causing JSON decode error:
```
{"tool_name":"upsert","args":"{\"text\":\"caf\xC3\"}"
```

Sasha: Looks like KV cache prefix truncation after quantization — cached prefix ended in multibyte char. When resumed, runtime appended continuation, producing broken UTF-8.

Anya: Is this only on q5/q8 or q4 as well? Which backend?

nightly-evals-bot: failing_variants: redwood-7b-q5_0-int8, redwood-7b-q8_0-int8; host: ded-gpu-04; runtime: v3.2.1-quant.

Liam: Can reproduce locally with the quant runner. Steps: `./tools/infer --model redwood-7b-q5_0-int8 --enable-kvcache --seed 42 --batch 1`. KV flush at step 17 truncates buffer. repro log:
```
[17:12:01] KV_FLUSH size=4096 -> wrote 4080 bytes (split at byte 4080, last byte 0xC3)
[17:12:01] APPEND continuation 0xA9 -> produced invalid utf-8
```

Devon: Possible fixes: 1) sanitize K/V cache flush to ensure multibyte boundaries, 2) serializer fallback to re-encode invalid sequences, 3) nightly check for decode errors. Also consider adding a small validation scrub for function-call outputs before passing to downstream tools.

Sasha: Agree. I'll open PR to guard cache flush and add serializer fallback. Tagging @Anya and @Liam for review.

Anya: On it. ETA EOD. Also adding a nightly metric: unicode_decode_errors per model_variant.

Liam: :thumbsup: Will review PR.
